description: Offline speech model manifest for VoiceOS. Models are NOT distributed with the repository; install them manually under the runtime models directory (see docs/MODEL_SETUP.md). Paths may be overridden with VOICEOS_KWS_MODEL_DIR / VOICEOS_STT_MODEL_DIR / VOICEOS_TTS_MODEL_DIR.

required.note: keyword list; keywords_jarvis.txt preferred, keywords.txt fallback

models.notes: Files may live in a model subdirectory; the engine searches recursively. keywords_jarvis.txt contains the BPE-tokenized 'hello jarvis' variants.

models.upstream: sherpa-onnx release assets (moonshine-base-en-int8); archive also kept locally as moonshine.tar.bz2
models.notes: Model type 'moonshine' is auto-detected from preprocess.onnx + encode*.onnx. A sherpa-onnx-moonshine-tiny-en-int8 fallback directory may also be present; the engine picks the best candidate.

models.upstream: sherpa-onnx release assets (vits-piper en_US lessac medium int8); archive also kept locally as lessac-int8.tar.bz2

required.note: token table inside the model directory
lexicon-en-us.txt or lexicon.txt, in model dir or parent

models.notes: espeak-ng-data must ship inside the model directory for phonemization.
